title: MoE Ethiopian Exit Exam: Architecture (2015)
description: Official Ministry of Education (MoE) Ethiopian University Exit Examination for Architecture (2015). Complete with detailed explanations.

questions.questionText: ______ is a preferred sampling method for the population with finite size.
questions.explanation: Systematic sampling is a preferred method for populations with finite size because it ensures a uniform selection process.

questions.questionText: ______ is a process of measuring or scaling dimensions from drawings and recording all dimensions in an easily understood format.
questions.explanation: Taking Off is the process of measuring dimensions from drawings and recording them in a structured format.

questions.questionText: ______ describe the construction supervision, construction project management including checking of payment certificates prepared by contractor and interpretation of contract document.
questions.explanation: Implementation services include construction supervision, project management, and contract document interpretation.

questions.questionText: ______ looks at the reasons why buildings look the way they do and why architects have chosen to design their buildings in particular ways.
questions.explanation: The theory of architecture examines the reasons behind architectural designs and choices.

questions.questionText: ______ are dynamic in character in that they vary in both magnitude and position.
questions.explanation: Live loads are dynamic and vary in magnitude and position, unlike dead loads which are static.

questions.questionText: ______ is an attempt to rebuild an element's structure or function in an ecological system.
questions.explanation: Restoration aims to rebuild an element's structure or function in an ecological system.

questions.questionText: ______ is an architectural and interior design approach that connects people with the natural environment.
questions.explanation: Biophilic Design focuses on connecting people with nature through architectural and interior design.

questions.questionText: ______ is a type of Architecture in which buildings and other structures are given unusual shapes.
questions.explanation: Novelty Architecture involves designing buildings with unusual and unique shapes.

questions.questionText: A gallery formed by a colonnade open on one or more sides, usually on the upper floor of a building is called a:
questions.explanation: A Loggia is a gallery formed by a colonnade open on one or more sides, typically on the upper floor.

questions.questionText: A heavy stone is suitable for the construction of:
questions.explanation: Heavy stones are suitable for retaining walls due to their strength and durability.

questions.questionText: A set of drawings which will tell you the location of a building on the plot is:
questions.explanation: A site plan shows the location of a building on the plot.

questions.questionText: A window above a window or door is called:
questions.explanation: A transom is a window above a door or another window.

questions.questionText: According to Neufert's spatial data; the minimum space required for a man with luggage in both hands is:
questions.explanation: Neufert's spatial data suggests that 120 cm is the minimum space required for a man with luggage.

questions.questionText: Among the following, one is not the major residential house typologies in Harar:
questions.explanation: The Egyptian type is not a major residential house typology in Harar.

questions.questionText: Among the following, Soil stabilization techniques involve tamping or compacting the soil by using a heavy weight to bring about a reduction in the air void volume to improve the construction quality.
questions.explanation: Mechanical stabilization involves tamping or compacting the soil to reduce air voids.

questions.questionText: Among the following, which one is a true statement about Comparable and shared qualities of design and research?
options: Both design and Research use logic models of Systematic Design Process
Both design and Research use Multiple Logics of Abductive, Inductive, and Deductive
Through the concepts of Social Context, both design and research are Situated Practice
questions.explanation: Both design and research use multiple logics, including abductive, inductive, and deductive reasoning.

questions.questionText: An outline or --- dimension line should never be used as a:
questions.explanation: An outline or dimension line should never be used as a center line.

questions.questionText: An overhead plane cannot be:
questions.explanation: An overhead plane cannot be perpendicular to the horizontal plane.

questions.questionText: By reading the instructions, calculate the heat flow rate for the following problem. USE: - Specific heat ex. for metal deck= 480, thatch straw 1420 and water 4176 J/kg.K Given 0.5kg of metal at 20°C in an electric jug with an 800W immersion heater element, how long will it take to reach 100°C?
questions.explanation: To calculate the time: Energy = mass × specific heat × temperature difference. Energy = 0.5kg × 480J/kg.K × (100-20)°C = 19,200J. With 800W (or 800J/s), time = 19,200J ÷ 800J/s = 24 seconds.

questions.questionText: Calculate the elongation if a steel rod of 40mm diameter and 4m long is subjected to an axial pull of 80kN. Take E= 200GPa.
questions.explanation: Using the formula: Elongation = (Force × Length)/(Area × Elastic Modulus). Area = π(40/2)² = 1256.6mm². Elongation = (80,000N × 4000mm)/(1256.6mm² × 200,000N/mm²) = 1.31mm.

questions.questionText: Choose an appropriate material to cover a large space with heavy loads:
questions.explanation: Steel is the most appropriate material for covering large spaces with heavy loads due to its strength.

questions.questionText: Color temperature is:
options: Has scale based on how blackbodies change color when heated
Lower color temperature will have a more blue color
Measured in the units of either Degree Celsius or Degree Fahrenheit
questions.explanation: Color temperature is based on how blackbodies change color when heated.

questions.questionText: From the following; one is not required during Structural system selection:
questions.explanation: Opening type used is not a primary consideration during structural system selection.

questions.questionText: In a conventional construction project, following an initial meeting to discuss the basics of the project, the Architect will follow up with a letter of proposal which contains the following except:
questions.explanation: Working drawings are not included in the initial letter of proposal.

questions.questionText: In stairs, the flier is:
options: The under surface of a stair
vertical portion of a step providing support to the tread
straight step having a parallel width of tread
The angle which the line of nosing of the stair makes with the horizontal
questions.explanation: A flier is a straight step with a parallel width of tread.

questions.questionText: In Traditional Ethiopian Architecture, which one of the following elements (furniture) has been built in Tigre farmer's house?
questions.explanation: All the listed elements are found in Tigre farmer's houses.

questions.questionText: In which city in Ethiopia was not influenced by Colonial Architecture?
questions.explanation: Bahirdar was not influenced by Colonial Architecture.

questions.questionText: Landscape Architecture is the design of outdoor public areas, landmarks, and structures to achieve:
questions.explanation: Landscape Architecture aims to achieve environmental, social-behavioral, and aesthetic outcomes.

questions.questionText: On the floor plan, the dashed line that appears approximately 24 inches outside the exterior wall represents the:
questions.explanation: The dashed line represents the roof overhang.

questions.questionText: One is incorrect:
options: Any room side should use up to 1 meter width
The riser of a stair is between 10cm to 15cm for hospital buildings
The minimum height of a residential building is 2.85m
Fire exit stairs should not be far from 15m at core circulation
questions.explanation: The statement 'Any room side should use up to 1 meter width' is incorrect. Rooms typically require more than 1 meter width to be functional. Standard architectural guidelines recommend minimum room dimensions much larger than this value.

questions.questionText: One is incorrect.
options: Chinese and Japanese Architecture is dependent on religion rather than geography and geology
Assyrian Arts is characterized by polychrome carved relief that decorated imperial monuments
Ancient Greek Architecture developed two distinct orders, the Doric and the Ionic
Ziggurats were huge pyramidal temple towers which were first built in Sumerian cities and then developed in Babylonia, Assyrian cities, and Elamites
questions.explanation: Chinese and Japanese Architecture is heavily influenced by geography, geology, and climate, not just religion. Their traditional architecture responds to local environmental conditions with features like earthquake-resistant construction techniques, courtyard designs for ventilation, and elevated structures to manage humidity.

questions.questionText: One is not based on the result of the architect's interpretation of the program in relation to:
options: The availability of materials and structural technology
questions.explanation: Manipulators' preference after design is not a factor in the architect's interpretation.

questions.questionText: One is totally unacceptable concerning the Architectural Design Process.
options: It involves the three phases of analysis, diagnosis, and synthesis.
Strategic design concepts are proposed in the diagnosis phase.
Analysis phase does not include the development of project programs.
questions.explanation: The analysis phase includes the development of project programs.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not from an ordering principle.
questions.explanation: Harmony is not an ordering principle but rather a design goal or result achieved through proper application of ordering principles. The six main ordering principles in architecture are: axis, symmetry, hierarchy, rhythm/repetition, datum, and transformation.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not a Principle of Building Planning.
questions.explanation: Formulation is not a principle of building planning.

questions.questionText: One of the following is not the characteristic feature of Royal College built in the colonial period.
questions.explanation: Articulated frames are not a characteristic feature of Royal College.

questions.questionText: Originated from the Pythagorean concept of 'all is number' and the belief that certain numerical relationships manifest the harmonic structure of the Universe.
questions.explanation: The Golden section is based on the Pythagorean concept of numerical harmony.

questions.questionText: Plywood has the advantages:
options: Greater tensile strength in the longer direction
Same tensile strength in the shorter direction
Same tensile strength in all directions
Greater tensile strength in the shorter direction
questions.explanation: Plywood has the same tensile strength in all directions.

questions.questionText: ______ Refers to the measurement of the size and the proportion of the human body.
questions.explanation: Anthropometric refers to the measurement of the size and proportion of the human body.

questions.questionText: Roman culture is the result of different influences:
options: Primitive cultures of the area Rome was founded in (they were peasants & warriors)
questions.explanation: Roman culture is influenced by all the listed factors.

questions.questionText: Stones used for ornamental work must be:
questions.explanation: Stones used for ornamental work must be soft to allow for detailed carving.

questions.questionText: The advantages of adopting a standard condition of contract are to:
options: Save time and cost of bid preparation and review
Ensure development of useful legal case history
questions.explanation: All the listed advantages are correct.

questions.questionText: The Architect who quoted that 'God is in details' is:
questions.explanation: Mies Van der Rohe is known for the quote 'God is in details'.

questions.questionText: The book titled 'Image of the City and its Elements' is written by:
questions.explanation: Kevin Lynch wrote 'The Image of the City' (1960), which introduces five key elements of urban form: paths, edges, districts, nodes, and landmarks. This influential book explores how people perceive and navigate urban environments.

questions.questionText: The Chroma of a color can be changed by adding to the color:
questions.explanation: The Chroma (or saturation/intensity) of a color is reduced by adding grey, which neutralizes the color's intensity while maintaining its hue. Adding black changes the value (making it darker), not primarily the chroma. Adding white creates tints and reduces saturation but is not the most direct way to alter chroma specifically.

questions.questionText: The function of building elevation is:
options: To show vertical arrangement and locations of rooms
To give dimension of exterior component of a building
To indicate the vertical location and shape of the building
questions.explanation: Building elevation indicates the vertical location and shape of the building.

questions.questionText: The method of vegetative propagation in which a part of the parent plant is made to root and then severed is called:
questions.explanation: Layering involves rooting a part of the parent plant and then severing it.

questions.questionText: The point of contact between mass and space is:
questions.explanation: In architectural theory, the plane is the point of contact between mass and space. Planes define the boundaries where mass meets space and provide the transition between these two fundamental elements of architectural composition.

questions.questionText: The purpose of specification is:
questions.explanation: The purpose of specifications is for supervising work - they provide detailed instructions for contractors about materials, workmanship, and installation methods to ensure the project meets quality standards. They serve as a reference for supervision and quality control during construction.

questions.questionText: The rate of an item of work is not dependent on:
questions.explanation: The rate of an item of work is not directly dependent on the scope of work. The rate is determined by specifications of work, specifications of materials, proportion of materials, labor costs, and market conditions. The scope (quantity) affects the total cost but not the unit rate.

questions.questionText: The site plan illustrates:
options: Where the garage and the driveway are located
Where the houses sit on properly
questions.explanation: The site plan shows where the houses sit on the property.

questions.questionText: The surface quality of objects that determine the character of elements coarseness or roughness of a surface is:
questions.explanation: Texture determines the coarseness or roughness of a surface.

questions.questionText: The type of Dynamics which deals with the geometry of motion of bodies without reference to the forces causing the motion is:
questions.explanation: Kinematics deals with the geometry of motion without considering forces.

questions.questionText: The water that is removed from the kitchen and shower room of a residential building is called:
questions.explanation: Grey water is the term for water from kitchens and showers.

questions.questionText: The window which is provided in the flat roof of a room is known as:
questions.explanation: A skylight or sky window is the window provided in a flat roof. A lantern window is actually a raised structure on a roof with vertical glazing on all sides, while a dormer window projects vertically from a sloping roof, not a flat roof.

questions.questionText: The windows provided above the eye level are called:
questions.explanation: Clerestory windows are placed above eye level.

questions.questionText: Urban design operates at 3 scales; which one is not one of them?
questions.explanation: The function-Circulation and street is not a scale of urban design.

questions.questionText: Weep holes are provided in retaining and breast walls:
options: To increase compaction of the earth
To drain off the water from the filling
questions.explanation: Weep holes are used to drain water from retaining walls.

questions.questionText: What does urban sprawl result in?
questions.explanation: Urban sprawl often results in increased traffic.

questions.questionText: What is meant by 'Composition based on Equality' from composition of elements type?
options: The targeted end result is harmonious in effect and creates some degree of visual tension.
There is no visual tension as the result of their placement and interaction in the compositional plane
There is an effect of maximum tension produced using elements that are different in their main feature
There are presence of placement variations creating unequal forces
questions.explanation: Composition based on Equality creates balance and harmony where elements have equal visual weight and importance. This results in no visual tension, as stated in option B, because the elements are in equilibrium, creating a sense of stability and resolution in the design.

questions.questionText: What is the name of an Architectural drawing showing a building exterior?
questions.explanation: An elevation is the architectural drawing that shows a building's exterior. Note that there's a duplicate option in the choices - 'Elevation' appears twice, while 'Façade' refers to the actual face of the building, not the drawing type.

questions.questionText: Which days are critical for hydration and hardening of concrete?
questions.explanation: The first seven days are critical for concrete hydration and hardening.

questions.questionText: Which one are not duties & liabilities of an architect?
options: Architect cannot enter into a contract with the contractor on behalf of the owner
Architect has no implied authority to obtain the tender
Architect cannot commit to the sub-contractors on behalf of the owner
There is an implied liability for the safety of the adjoining buildings when executing work
questions.explanation: Contrary to the option, it IS a duty and liability of an architect that they cannot enter into a contract with the contractor on behalf of the owner without specific authority. The correct answer should be an option that is NOT a duty or liability of an architect.

questions.questionText: Which one are the suggestions of the origin of Rock churches?
options: The origin of foreign monks (Saints) coming from Egypt and Syria
The Indian rock-cut temples as a source of inspiration
Rock churches were transformed to Christian worship centers from previous pagan sites
questions.explanation: All the listed suggestions are possible origins of Rock churches.

questions.questionText: Which one can be recognized as visual elements of design?
questions.explanation: Plane is a visual element of design.

questions.questionText: Which one can describe dimensional transformation among the following?
options: Form can be transformed through discreet changes in length, width, or height
form is produced by the addition of another form to its volume
Forms can be characterized by their ability to grow and merge with other forms
form can retain its initial identity or be transformed into a form of another family
questions.explanation: Dimensional transformation involves changes in length, width, or height.

questions.questionText: Which one can signify the sense of stability from the following primary shapes?
questions.explanation: The rectangle signifies stability in design due to its balanced proportions and right angles. Its horizontal orientation provides a visual sense of groundedness, while its regular form suggests permanence and structural soundness—making it the shape most associated with stability in architectural and design composition.

questions.questionText: Which one is a part of a residential building programming?
questions.explanation: Site and orientation requirements are part of residential building programming.

questions.questionText: Which one is incorrect about Architectural research?
options: Research is a systematic investigation to produce knowledge
Research is a systematic phenomenon to dig out existing problems
Researcher learned a scientific culture in order to produce good quality research
Research report compilation is after gathering data
questions.explanation: Research is not just about digging out existing problems but also generating new knowledge.

questions.questionText: Which one is incorrect about Light rays of a conventional shadow, it should be drawn at:
options: Whichever angle the sun is shining
The angle of the inclined plane
questions.explanation: Light rays in conventional shadow representations aren't fixed at 15°. This is incorrect as light angles vary depending on the sun's position, time of day, and geographic location. Conventional architectural drawings often use 30°-45° angles for shadows.

questions.questionText: Which one is incorrect about the principle of design in Architecture?
options: Scale shows how to perceive or judge the size of something in relation to something else
Value refers to the size variety of object design
Proportion refers to the proper or harmonious relation of one part to another part
Ratio refers to the qualitative comparison of two similar things
questions.explanation: Value does not refer to the size variety of object design.

questions.questionText: Which one is incorrect about Stone Masonry?
options: Squared rubble - coursed, built to courses and irregular
Random rubble - no coursed and built to courses
Miscellaneous - polygonal, flint, and lake district masonry
Ashlar work - accurately dressed, sized, and coursed
questions.explanation: Random rubble is not built to courses.

questions.questionText: Which one is incorrect about vector?
options: Vector possessing parameters such as mass, volume, temperature
Negative vector of a given vector has the same magnitude and the opposite direction
Equal vectors have the same magnitude and direction
Vector is parameters possessing magnitude and direction
questions.explanation: Vectors do not possess parameters like mass, volume, or temperature.

questions.questionText: Which one is incorrect shelter in cold climates?
options: Flat roofs and semi-open areas are used
Concrete/Cement Blocks, Sand-cement blocks are used as walling material
Elongated or spread-out planning is better than a compact to increasing wind-facing surface
Thick walls prevent heat loss from the inner area of the building
questions.explanation: In cold climates, flat roofs and semi-open areas are NOT typically used, as they increase heat loss. Pitched roofs that shed snow and fully enclosed spaces are preferred for cold climate shelters to maximize heat retention.

questions.questionText: Which one is a mathematical analogy as a basis for architecture theory?
questions.explanation: The grammatical model is a mathematical analogy in architecture theory.

questions.questionText: Which one is not a factor affecting building decision?
questions.explanation: The color of the building is not a primary factor in building decisions.

questions.questionText: Which one is not an appropriate method for data collection?
options: Nature, scope, and object of enquiry
Precision required to be taken account
questions.explanation: Availability of funds is not a method for data collection.

questions.questionText: Which one is not a faulty workmanship in plastering?
options: Addition of water to hydraulic lime after initial set has taken place may prove to be harmful
Excessive trawling may cause the binder to come to the surface
The interval between successive applications may be short
The coats are perfect but there is a wastage of time
questions.explanation: Perfect coats with time wastage are not faulty workmanship.

questions.questionText: Which one is not the major shortcoming of pneumatic structures in Architecture?
options: Significant construction of large and permanent buildings
questions.explanation: Pneumatic structures actually have good form load-bearing capabilities for air-buildings, as the air pressure creates a strong tension structure. Their shortcomings include load limitations, difficulty in creating permanent buildings, and form restrictions due to the need for continuous pressurization.

questions.questionText: Which one is not the objective of Architectural research work?
options: To promote architectural research and development
To strengthen the standard of building safety and construction technology
To show our knowledge and skill of Architectural design
To improve the quality of the living environment
questions.explanation: Showing knowledge and skill is not the primary objective of research.

questions.questionText: Which one is a surface type structure?
questions.explanation: Grids, plates, shells, and stressed skins are surface-type structures.

questions.questionText: Which one is the correct path in the process of quantity surveying?
options: Taking off, squaring, writing the final bill, abstracting
Taking off, squaring, abstracting, writing the final bill
Taking off, writing the final bill, squaring, abstracting
Taking off, abstracting, squaring, writing the final bill
questions.explanation: The correct path is Taking off, squaring, abstracting, and writing the final bill.

questions.questionText: Which one is the tender document preparation phase?
options: Preparation of advertisement in connection with invitation to bid
Participation in tender analysis and award recommendation
questions.explanation: Preparation of advertisement is part of tender document preparation.

questions.questionText: Which one is the type of symmetry?
questions.explanation: Radial symmetry is a type of symmetry.

questions.questionText: Which one is wrong about Architectural Design Concept development?
options: Assigns meanings, enhances creativity, and guides the Design Process to produce a design product
Concept represents a bridge between the process and solution
Producing a design concept gives major energy for some step of Design Process
concept is an approach idea to the design
questions.explanation: Producing a design concept does not give major energy for some steps of the Design Process.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following castle and church in Gondar inscribed on UNESCO's world heritage list in 1979?
options: Qusquam Debre Tsehai church and palace
questions.explanation: All the listed sites are inscribed on UNESCO's world heritage list.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following correct orders of Urban Design Process you should use after your analysis/findings on your thesis research project; if the topic area of your research could be urban?
questions.explanation: The correct order is Analysis, Synthesis, Evaluation, and Implementation.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a principle of Le Corbusier's Radiant City?
questions.explanation: Le Corbusier's five points of architecture for the Radiant City included: pilotis (columns), roof gardens, free plan, ribbon windows (horizontal, not vertical), and free façade. Vertical windows were not a principle—in fact, he specifically advocated for horizontal ribbon windows.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is a false statement about the contents of Bid document?
options: Consists of General conditions of contract and Special conditions of contract
Comprises of Instruction to bidders and Bill of quantities
Comprises of Technical specification and a Schedule of supplementary information
questions.explanation: All the listed contents are part of a Bid document.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is incorrectly defined about the Parts of Islamic Architecture?
options: Mausoleum: - Muslim center at place for worship
Hammam: - A structural design for a hot bathhouse.
questions.explanation: A Mausoleum is not a Muslim center for worship. It is a building that houses a tomb or group of tombs, serving as a memorial structure. The mosque (masjid) is the Muslim center for worship.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is not a type of Portland cement?
questions.explanation: Low-late-Strength is not a type of Portland cement.

questions.questionText: Which one of the following is the main and important strategy of passive cooling?
questions.explanation: All the listed strategies are important for passive cooling.

questions.questionText: Which types of research project identification or selection is the most important?
questions.explanation: Practical concerns are considered the most important factor in research project identification because they ensure the research addresses real-world problems, has direct applications, and potentially provides tangible benefits to society. Research that addresses practical concerns is more likely to receive funding, institutional support, and produce usable outcomes.

questions.questionText: Who was the name entitled by 'Father of American Landscape Architecture'?
questions.explanation: Frederick Law Olmsted is known as the 'Father of American Landscape Architecture'.

questions.questionText: Why research is controlled?
options: To minimize laboratory conditions or expensive equipment
To measure/observe all the parameters at the same time
questions.explanation: Research is controlled to measure/observe all parameters simultaneously.

questions.questionText: The perceptions of our brain on the environment are depending upon the psychological needs and ability to interpret or understanding. The choice of wall colors can make a space seem larger or smaller than it actual. Therefore, which one of the following colors mismatched with the psychological interpretations and meanings?
questions.explanation: Orange is primarily associated with warmth, enthusiasm, creativity, and stimulation - not with unambiguousness (clarity/certainty) as suggested in the option. While orange does convey warmth or 'hotness', the term 'unambiguousness' is incorrectly associated with this color in architectural color psychology.

questions.questionText: In the building systems heat transfer by means of contact of two bodies in collision is called _____
questions.explanation: Conduction is the process of heat transfer through direct contact.

questions.questionText: In both the heating and cooling of buildings, a major design decision is the choice of the energy-transfer medium. What are the most common alternatives of energy-transfer medium?
questions.explanation: Air and water are the most common energy-transfer mediums in building systems.

questions.questionText: What are the advantages of using electric lighting instead of using daylighting in the buildings?
options: It is the ease and flexibility it allowable
Its ability to satisfy biological and human needs
It is connecting with natural, satisfies psychological rhythms
It can also reduce the heating and cooling energy consumption
questions.explanation: Electric lighting provides ease and flexibility in design and usage.

questions.questionText: In northern latitudes, where winter days are short, depression is more common in the winter than in the summer. This illness is now called __________
questions.explanation: Seasonal affective disorder (SAD) is a type of depression that occurs at a specific time of year, usually in winter.
